scenes.headline:
Set up once.
Start prepared.
scenes.caption: Save contact, experience, and education before the next application.
scenes.capture: Open Your application profile; show fictional contact, experience and education records.

scenes.headline:
Less typing.
More possibility.
scenes.caption: Fill supported empty fields, then review the result.
scenes.capture: Show empty supported contact fields, click Prefill, pause on result; show a pre-entered field remains unchanged.

scenes.headline:
Your experience.
The right emphasis.
scenes.caption: Prepare a résumé for this role using your real experience.
scenes.capture: Open a demo job, choose source resume, generate or show a previously generated tailored result, review it.

scenes.headline:
One clear story.
Six ways to tell it.
scenes.caption: Choose a résumé template that suits your experience.
scenes.capture: Open the real template selector; show its six options, then preview one. Do not imply six outputs were generated.

scenes.headline:
See how
you fit.
scenes.caption: Compare your résumé with the role and review keyword gaps.
scenes.capture: Show actual job-fit analysis for the fictional resume; pause at relevant skills and a gap.

scenes.headline:
Find the words.
Keep your voice.
scenes.caption: Review drafts grounded in your résumé and this role.
scenes.capture: Show one supported screening question, generate or reuse a genuine draft, then review the marked answer.

scenes.headline:
A stronger
starting draft.
scenes.caption: Create a cover letter grounded in your experience.
scenes.capture: Show the actual cover-letter control and its draft review panel.

scenes.headline:
Keep the role.
Keep the context.
scenes.caption: Save a job from its page and follow your progress.
scenes.capture: Save a fictional/demo opportunity with Add this job to tracker; inspect role/company before confirming.

scenes.headline:
Stay in
your flow.
scenes.caption: Reuse loaded answers on supported steps of the same application.
scenes.capture: Show enabled Continuous mode on an eligible plan; manually move to a supported step and show reused answers.

scenes.headline:
Move forward.
Stay in control.
scenes.caption: Opt-in guidance that stops before final submission.
scenes.capture: Enable Guided Autopilot in a safe demo application; record supported progression and a visible review stop. Never submit.

scenes.headline:
Your answers.
Ready when you are.
scenes.caption: Reuse optional saved answers when you click Prefill.
scenes.capture: Demonstrate a fictional work-authorization response on a demo form; avoid any actual private profile values.

scenes.headline:
One less thing
to retype.
scenes.caption: Fill saved details. You choose when to sign in.
scenes.capture: Use an HTTPS demo login form with fictional credentials; show password masked and Sign in unpressed.

scenes.headline:
Your OPT timeline.
In focus.
scenes.caption: Plan filing dates and follow employment history.
scenes.capture: Show actual OPT Apply Date and OPT Clock with explicitly fictional records. Keep DSO context visible.

scenes.headline:
See your
next chapter.
scenes.caption: Organize your STEM timeline alongside earlier OPT history.
scenes.capture: Show STEM Apply Date and STEM Clock using fictional dates; include earlier OPT employment history.
